name: shadow_tier3_projection
description: CEQR Tier 3 shadow screening. Projects accurate 3D shadows using pysolar ephemeris and UTM geometry. Analyzes CEQR representative days (Dec 21, Mar 21, May 6, Jun 21) within the 1.5-hour-after-sunrise to 1.5-hour-before-sunset window. Determines if shadows reach sensitive resources.

building_geojson.description: Building footprint geometry in GeoJSON format

building_height_ft.description: Building height in feet including all rooftop equipment

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction determines default analysis dates. NYC uses CEQR representative days.

sensitive_sites.description: Sensitive sites to check for shadow impacts. If omitted, uses default NYC dataset.

analysis_dates.description: Dates for shadow analysis (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to CEQR representative days based on jurisdiction.

shadow_polygons.description: Shadow polygon for each analysis time snapshot (one feature per datetime)

sites_affected.description: List of sensitive sites that receive shadow, with enter/exit times and duration per analysis day

summary_report.description: Detailed report of shadow projection results per CEQR methodology

visualization.description: Interactive map showing shadow sweeps for each analysis day with sensitive sites
